title: Halo Dental button
description: Squarish 40px buttons with 4px corners and a regular-weight label: orange fill with ink text, a solid light fill for black panels, a 1px outline, a see-through square tile and a small card square for arrow links. Optional leading icon in a darker square.
notes: light and tile are meant for black panels (put them inside an element with the `dark` class)
name: halodental-opus-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label; leave empty for an icon-only square (give it an `ariaLabel`)

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: orange fill with ink text · light: solid foreground fill (white on a black
panel) · outline: 1px foreground border, no fill · tile: a quiet see-through square
(menu, language, accessibility) · card: a small card-coloured square (arrow links)

props.name: lead
props.description: an icon in a slightly darker square at the start, as on the "play" button

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: screen-reader label, needed when there's no visible text

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
